name: Jehu
bio: Jehu son of Nimshi is first named at Horeb, where the LORD instructed Elijah to anoint him king over Israel (1 Kings 19:16) — one of three anointings Elijah was told to carry out, alongside Hazael as king over Syria and Elisha as prophet in his own place. The LORD declared that whoever escaped Hazael's sword, Jehu would slay, and whoever escaped Jehu's sword, Elisha would slay, marking Jehu as an instrument of judgment against the house of Ahab and against Baal worship in Israel (1 Kings 19:15-18). His eventual rise to the throne and his violent purge of Ahab's dynasty are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
